headline: Senior Software Engineer  |  Solutions Architect
summary: Senior software engineer and solutions architect with 20+ years of hands-on delivery across the .NET and Azure stack — C#, .NET Core, ASP.NET Core, Azure App Service-hosted systems, and message-driven integrations (Azure Service Bus, WCF, ActiveMQ, protobuf). Most comfortable owning a system end-to-end: architecture, implementation, CI/CD, and production support, especially inside complex, partially documented environments where stabilizing a brittle integration is the actual job. A decade running an independent consulting practice, and current experience directing delivery teams, have both stayed close to the technical work by design — looking for a senior individual-contributor role to bring that same hands-on ownership to a single team and codebase, rather than split across managing others. Experience spans healthcare, aviation, financial services, telecom, and logistics, most of it dealing with sensitive or regulated data.

Data & Integration: Azure Service Bus (extensive) — asynchronous, message-driven integration patterns

highlights: Designed an application that increased customers reached by 40% on day one, stabilizing at ~60% within a week.
Worked with classic ASP, VB.NET, VBScript, ASP.NET Web Forms, AD-integrated security, workflow tools, and Windows services (WCF) and APIs using Telerik controls for consistent UI.
